COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) ADVISORY COMMITTEE

Welcome to the meeting of the Community Development Block Grant Advisory Committee. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast
throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by calling (818) 548-2090.
Meetings are also archived on the City website for viewing anytime at www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp.
PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon
request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign
language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206.
If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-2782 during regular business hours.

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Monday, April 22, 2019, 2:30 p.m.
  Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206

A SPECIAL MEETING of the CDBG Advisory Committee is hereby called to meet at 2:30 p.m. on Monday,
April 22, 2019, in the City Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206 to consider
the following item of business, to wit:

1.  ROLL CALL
  A. Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the April 22, 2019, special
  meeting of the CDBG Advisory Committee was posted on or before Friday, April 19, 2019, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
2.  MINUTES
  A. Approval of the Minutes of the February 22, 2019, CDBG Advisory Committee Special Meeting.
3.  ACTION ITEMS
  A. Report Regarding Release of CDBG Funding Allocations for FY2019-2020 from Housing and
  Urban Development (HUD)
  1.  Committee to deliberate and approve additional CIP funding recommendations
  2.  Committee to deliberate and approve additional Social Services funding recommendations.
4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5) minutes. The
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. Staff may refer the
  matter to the proper section or department for investigation and report.
5.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS
6.  ADJOURNMENT

  Onnig Bulanikian
  Director of Community Services & Parks
  -------
  ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SERVICE
  Members of the public may address the CDBG Advisory Committee regarding any item in this notice.
  Service of the above Call for Special Meeting of the CDBG Advisory Committee, at the time and place
  above designated, is hereby acknowledged, and the Notice required by Government Code Section
  54956 is hereby waived:
  Hour:  a.m./p.m., this  day of  , 20 .
  By: ____________________________Title: CDBG Advisory Committee Member
minutes_text:
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES
  Monday, April 22, 2019, 2:30 p.m.
  Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206

1.  ROLL CALL
  The meeting began at 2:34 p.m.

  Present: Avedisian, Ghazarian, Ramirez, Gharibian
  Absent: Armenian
  Staff:  Bulanikian, Aleksanian, Kavarian, Hoonanian, Moreno Hernandez

  A.  Recording Secretary Iris Moreno Hernandez reported that the Agenda for the April 22, 2019,
  special meeting of the CDBG Advisory Committee was posted on or before Friday, April 19, 2019,
  on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
2.  MINUTES
  A. Approval of the Minutes of the February 22, 2019, CDBG Advisory Committee Special Meeting.
  Moved: Ramirez  Second: Avedisian

  Vote as Follows:
  Ayes:  Avedisian, Ghazarian, Ramirez, Gharibian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Armenian
  Abstained: None
3.  ACTION ITEMS
  A. Report Regarding Release of CDBG Funding Allocations for FY2019-2020 from Housing and
  Urban Development (HUD)
  1.  Committee to deliberate and approve additional CIP funding recommendations

  Sr. Community Services Supervisor Maggie Kavarian provided a report.

  Armond Gorgorian, Executive Director of Homenetmen Ararat Chapter, addressed the
  Committee to let them know that Homenetmen did not need additional funds for its FY 2019-
  2020 CIP projects.

  At this time, the Committee asked other agencies present to introduce themselves, which
  included: Catholic Charities for both CIP and Social Services, and Salvation Army, Armenian
  Relief Society of Western USA, and Ascencia for Social Services.

  Committee Member Ramirez asked for clarification regarding the public’s ability to speak on
  items that are part of the agenda. Ms. Moreno Hernandez and Deputy Director Tereza
  Aleksanian explained that the public can speak during any item that is part of the agenda by
  submitting a Request to Speak card that specifies the item during which they wish to speak,
  noting that it is the same card used for requesting to speak during Oral Communications on
  topics not a part of the agenda. Committee Member Ramirez suggested that language be
  added to the agenda making it clear to the public of such opportunity and process to speak
  during any item on the agenda in a similar way that it is noted under Oral Communications.
   Ms. Aleksanian said that while the CDBG Advisory Committee Meeting agendas utilize a
  similar format to Council agenda’s, staff would consult the City’s legal team about the
  opportunity to improve the agenda.

  After some discussion, a motion was made recommending the following additional CIP funding
  allocation for FY 2019-2020:

  FY 19-20
  RECOMMENDED
  PROGRAM  ADDITONAL FUNDING
  Lexington Building #1 Facility Improvements – YWCA of
  Glendale  $  21,544
  Glendale Community Center Facility Improvements -
  Catholic Charities of Los Angeles, Inc.  $  30,000

  Moved: Ghazarian  Second: Ramirez

  Vote as Follows:
  Ayes:  Avedisian, Ghazarian, Ramirez, Gharibian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Armenian
  Abstained:  None

  2.  Committee to deliberate and approve additional Social Services funding recommendations.

  Ms. Kavarian provided a report.

  After some discussion, a motion was made recommending the following additional Social
  Services funding allocation for FY 2019-2020:

  FY 19-20
  RECOMMENDED
  PROGRAM  ADDITONAL FUNDING
  Community Outreach Program - Armenian Relief Society of
  Western USA,Inc.  $  5,500
  The Zone - The Salvation Army  $  3,397
  We Got Skillz - Homenetmen Shant Chapter  $  1,500
  Intergenerational Experiences - Armenian Cultural
  Association, Hamazkayin  $  1,500

  Moved: Ghazarian  Second: Avedisian

  Vote as Follows:
  Ayes:  Avedisian, Ghazarian, Gharibian
  Noes:  Ramirez
  Absent:  Armenian
  Abstained:  None

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  None.
5.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

  Administrative Analyst Armineh Hoonanian announced an upcoming Housing Rights Center Workshop.
   Ms. Kavarian announced the date of the Joint City Council and Housing Authority meeting in which the
  Committee’s recommendations would be presented, as well as the kickoff to National Community
  Development week. She also mentioned that staff is seeking a contractor to help staff with the
  preparation of two very important documents that are a HUD requirement, the 5-year Consolidated Plan
  and Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing.
6.  ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 3:46 p.m.
